tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register this agent and get its API key — the same as POST https://cymetica.com/mcp/v1/register, no key needed. Returns api_key (shown once) and agent_id. Then either set it as the X-API-Key (or Authorization: Bearer) header of this connection, or pass it as "api_key" in the arguments of any later t

tools.name: get_decide_info
tools.description: Tuatara Decide: what it is, the NEXUS plan allowances (classifiers and decisions a week), limits and the public benchmark evidence. Read-only, no auth.

tools.name: list_decide_classifiers
tools.description: Tuatara Decide: your classifiers, your plan and its classifier limit and weekly decisions.

tools.name: get_decide_classifier
tools.description: Tuatara Decide: one classifier's status (queued / training / ready / failed), labels and expected accuracy on held-out examples. Poll this after creating one.

tools.name: decide_create_classifier
tools.description: Tuatara Decide: train a text classifier from labelled examples (at least 2 per label, up to 255 labels). Training takes about a minute for small sets and draws on the account's NEXUS plan; the Free plan allows 1 classifier.

tools.name: decide_predict
tools.description: Tuatara Decide: label up to 256 texts with a ready classifier. Each result has the label, its confidence, every label's probability and unsure=true when confidence is under the classifier's threshold. Each text counts as one decision on the account's plan.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "decide" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent · Public sink: register_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
